correctness.rationale: The unordered two-point Abrams cubical model has C0=binom(2n+1,2), C1=3n(2n−1), C2=5n(n−1)/2; subdivision conditions hold for n>=2 with all 3-cycles and one essential hub. Spoke/outer edge square cells and outer/outer square cells give signed 1-cell pivot rows assembling a unimodular square minor of ∂2. Hence ∂2 injective primitive, H2=0, H1 torsion-free and rank 1+3 binom(n,2) by connectedness and Euler characteristic. Signed rational chain modules C0=U⊕Q, C1=Q⊕∧²U⊕A⊕D, C2=D⊕∧²A cancel to [H1]=[1]−[U]+[∧²U]+[A]−[∧²A], which splits as ∧² B_n^0 ⊕ B_n⊗A_n using U=B_n⊕A_n and Maschke. Character χ=((f−1)²−(f2−1))/2+f*t from exterior-square formula. Invariants: full wreath action 0, permutation-only Sn action dimension2, via rational finite-group transfer. Independently enumerated signed cellular Lefschetz character for every 8 W2 and 48 W3 group elements with direct cell maps. The all-n result relies on chain-module proof and equivariant naturality of the two-particle discrete deformation, not these bounded checks.
